description: DEVOS-007 + DEVOS-008: Wire DevOSBottomBar into MainActivity Scaffold and wire all placeholder routes into DevOSNavGraph. This unblocks runtime launch. Independent of FEAT-003/004 but depends on FEAT-001 (DevOSBottomBar must exist).
steps: 1. Update app/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/MainActivity.kt to use a Scaffold with bottomBar = { DevOSBottomBar(currentRoute = currentRoute, onNavigate = { navController.navigate(it) }) }. Track currentRoute via navController.currentBackStackEntryAsState(). Only show BottomBar on primary tab routes (HOME, PROJECT_LIST, AI_CHAT, LEARNING_DASHBOARD, MORE). Pass navController to DevOSNavGraph.

2. Create app/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/navigation/PlaceholderScreen.kt — a simple composable `fun PlaceholderScreen(route: String)` that shows a centered Column with route name Text. This is used for all unimplemented routes.

3. Update app/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/navigation/DevOSNavGraph.kt: add composable() entries for EVERY route defined in DevOSRoutes. Routes with path args (e.g. {projectId}) use navArgument() with type StringType. For all routes, render PlaceholderScreen(route). Uncomment the navigation extension calls once feature modules provide them — for now use the placeholder pattern.
4. Specifically for SPLASH, ONBOARDING, LOGIN: use PlaceholderScreen but also add a TODO comment noting these will be replaced in FEAT-003.
5. Run ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug and fix any import or NavHost errors.
6. Verify the NavHost has at least the SPLASH startDestination composable registered — the one crash guaranteed without this.
acceptance_criteria: DevOSNavGraph has composable() entries for SPLASH, ONBOARDING, LOGIN, HOME, PROJECT_LIST, AI_CHAT, LEARNING_DASHBOARD, MORE — PASS
MainActivity uses Scaffold with DevOSBottomBar as bottomBar — PASS
BottomBar is hidden on SPLASH, ONBOARDING, and LOGIN routes — PASS
App launches without crash on device/emulator (NavHost startDestination = SPLASH resolves) — PASS
findings: All 3 files implemented cleanly. MainActivity.kt replaced Surface with Scaffold; navController created in setContent scope; currentRoute derived from currentBackStackEntryAsState(). BOTTOM_BAR_HIDDEN_ROUTES set contains SPLASH/ONBOARDING/LOGIN; showBottomBar flag controls conditional rendering. Tab navigation uses popUpTo(HOME) + launchSingleTop + restoreState for standard Android tab UX. PlaceholderScreen.kt shows route name + 'Coming soon' with Icons.Outlined.Construction icon. DevOSNavGraph.kt registers all 40+ routes from DevOSRoutes with proper navArgument() entries for path-param routes; query param routes (FILE_EXPLORER, CODE_VIEWER, CODE_SEARCH, SEARCH) use defaultValue. SPLASH/ONBOARDING/LOGIN have TODO(FEAT-003) comments. Build: BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 2s, 459 tasks up-to-date.
